concepts.name: Secure baselines
concepts.description: Establish, deploy, and maintain approved configuration baselines for computing resources.

concepts.name: Hardening targets
concepts.description: Apply appropriate hardening to mobile devices, workstations, switches, routers, cloud infrastructure, servers, ICS/SCADA, embedded systems, RTOS, and IoT devices.

concepts.name: Wireless site surveys and heat maps
concepts.description: Use site surveys and heat maps to plan wireless coverage and identify signal or placement concerns.

concepts.name: Mobile device management
concepts.description: Use MDM to enforce mobile configuration, security, and management requirements.

concepts.name: Mobile deployment models
concepts.description: Distinguish BYOD, COPE, and CYOD ownership and control models.

concepts.name: Mobile connection methods
concepts.description: Recognize security considerations for cellular, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth connections.

concepts.name: Wireless authentication and encryption
concepts.description: Apply WPA3, RADIUS-backed AAA, cryptographic protocols, and authentication protocols to wireless access.

concepts.name: Application input validation
concepts.description: Validate untrusted input so applications reject malformed or unexpected data before processing it.

concepts.name: Secure cookies
concepts.description: Use cookie security attributes and protected transport to reduce session theft and misuse.

concepts.name: Static code analysis
concepts.description: Analyze source or compiled code without executing the application to find potential weaknesses.

concepts.name: Code signing
concepts.description: Use digital signatures to provide software origin and integrity assurance.

concepts.name: Sandboxing and monitoring
concepts.description: Constrain untrusted execution and monitor resources for suspicious or noncompliant behavior.

concepts.name: Asset lifecycle
concepts.description: Manage assets from acquisition through assignment, tracking, retention, and decommissioning.

concepts.name: Asset ownership and classification
concepts.description: Assign accountable owners and classify assets or data so handling requirements are clear.

concepts.name: Inventory and enumeration
concepts.description: Maintain asset inventories and enumerate discovered hardware, software, services, or data.

concepts.name: Sanitization and destruction
concepts.description: Choose sanitization or physical destruction based on media, sensitivity, reuse needs, and risk.

concepts.name: Retention and disposal certification
concepts.description: Retain data for required periods and document or certify completed disposal when required.

concepts.name: Vulnerability scanning
concepts.description: Use vulnerability scans to identify known weaknesses and misconfigurations at scale.

concepts.name: Application vulnerability identification
concepts.description: Use static analysis, dynamic analysis, and package monitoring to find application weaknesses.

concepts.name: Threat intelligence feeds
concepts.description: Use OSINT, commercial feeds, sharing organizations, and other sources to enrich vulnerability decisions.

concepts.name: Penetration testing and responsible disclosure
concepts.description: Use authorized testing and responsible disclosure or bug bounty processes to identify and report weaknesses.

concepts.name: Finding confirmation
concepts.description: Validate findings and distinguish false positives from false negatives.

concepts.name: CVE and CVSS
concepts.description: Use CVE identifiers to reference vulnerabilities and CVSS to communicate vulnerability severity characteristics.

concepts.name: Contextual vulnerability prioritization
concepts.description: Perform vulnerability classification and prioritization using CVSS, exposure factor, environmental variables, industry or organizational impact, risk tolerance, and other context.

concepts.name: Vulnerability response and remediation
concepts.description: Respond with patching, segmentation, compensating controls, insurance, or other approved treatments.

concepts.name: Exceptions and exemptions
concepts.description: Document approved deviations when standard remediation cannot or should not be applied.

concepts.name: Remediation validation and reporting
concepts.description: Rescan, audit, verify, and report to confirm remediation worked and communicate remaining risk.

concepts.name: Monitoring systems, applications, and infrastructure
concepts.description: Monitor computing resources across systems, applications, and infrastructure.

concepts.name: Monitoring activities
concepts.description: Aggregate, alert, scan, report, archive, respond, remediate, and validate as part of monitoring operations.

concepts.name: Quarantine and alert tuning
concepts.description: Contain suspicious resources when appropriate and tune alerts to improve useful signal.

concepts.name: SCAP and benchmarks
concepts.description: Use standardized security content and benchmarks to support automated configuration or vulnerability assessment.

concepts.name: Agent-based and agentless monitoring
concepts.description: Choose installed agents or remote agentless collection based on visibility and operational constraints.

concepts.name: Security information and event management
concepts.description: Centralize and correlate security event data for detection, investigation, and reporting.

concepts.name: Antivirus and DLP monitoring
concepts.description: Use antimalware and data loss prevention controls for different monitoring goals.

concepts.name: SNMP traps and NetFlow
concepts.description: Use SNMP traps for device-generated management notifications and NetFlow for summarized network flow telemetry.

concepts.name: Vulnerability scanner operations
concepts.description: Use vulnerability scanners as monitoring tools to identify and track weaknesses.

concepts.name: Firewall policy and screened subnets
concepts.description: Modify firewall rules, access lists, ports, protocols, and screened subnets to reduce exposure.

concepts.name: IDS/IPS trends and signatures
concepts.description: Use IDS/IPS signatures and observed trends to detect or block suspicious activity.

concepts.name: Web filtering
concepts.description: Use an agent-based filter or centralized proxy with URL scanning, content categorization, block rules, and reputation controls.

concepts.name: Operating-system security policy
concepts.description: Use controls such as Group Policy and SELinux to enforce operating-system security.

concepts.name: Secure protocol implementation
concepts.description: Select appropriate protocols, ports, and transport protections instead of insecure alternatives.

concepts.name: DNS filtering
concepts.description: Block or redirect resolution for known malicious or disallowed destinations.

concepts.name: Email sender authentication and gateways
concepts.description: Use SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and email gateways to reduce spoofing and filter messages.

concepts.name: File integrity monitoring
concepts.description: Detect unauthorized or unexpected changes to important files.

concepts.name: Data loss prevention
concepts.description: Detect or prevent sensitive data from leaving approved locations or channels.

concepts.name: Network access control
concepts.description: Evaluate device or user access before allowing network connectivity and apply policy based on posture.

concepts.name: EDR and XDR
concepts.description: Use endpoint detection and response and broader cross-source detection/response capabilities.

concepts.name: User behavior analytics
concepts.description: Analyze user activity for deviations from established patterns that may indicate risk.

concepts.name: Account provisioning and deprovisioning
concepts.description: Create, modify, and disable accounts in step with approved identity lifecycle events.

concepts.name: Permissions and least privilege
concepts.description: Assign only the permissions needed and understand the impact of excessive privileges.

concepts.name: Identity proofing
concepts.description: Establish sufficient evidence that a claimed real-world identity belongs to the applicant.

concepts.name: Federation and single sign-on
concepts.description: Use trusted identity relationships and SSO to access multiple services without separate primary authentication at each service.

concepts.name: LDAP, OAuth, and SAML
concepts.description: Distinguish directory access, delegated authorization, and federation/assertion protocols.

concepts.name: Interoperability and attestation
concepts.description: Support compatible identity exchanges and periodically verify that access remains appropriate.

concepts.name: Access control models
concepts.description: Distinguish mandatory, discretionary, role-based, rule-based, and attribute-based access control.

concepts.name: Time restrictions and least privilege
concepts.description: Limit access by time, role, need, or other approved policy conditions.

concepts.name: Multifactor authentication
concepts.description: Require independent authentication factors and choose appropriate authenticators.

concepts.name: Authentication factors
concepts.description: Distinguish knowledge, possession, inherence, and location factors.

concepts.name: Password practices and managers
concepts.description: Manage password length, reuse, compromise response, and secure storage with password managers.

concepts.name: Passwordless authentication
concepts.description: Authenticate without a memorized password by using approved cryptographic authenticators or equivalent mechanisms.

concepts.name: Privileged access management
concepts.description: Control privileged access with mechanisms such as just-in-time permissions, vaulting, and ephemeral credentials.

concepts.name: Security automation use cases
concepts.description: Automate user provisioning, resource provisioning, guard rails, security groups, ticket creation, escalation, and enabling/disabling services and access.

concepts.name: CI, testing, integrations, and APIs
concepts.description: Integrate security automation into continuous integration, testing, and API-driven workflows.

concepts.name: Automation benefits
concepts.description: Gain efficiency, consistency, secure scaling, faster reaction, and workforce leverage through well-designed automation.

concepts.name: Automation tradeoffs
concepts.description: Account for complexity, cost, single points of failure, technical debt, and ongoing supportability.

concepts.name: Incident response process
concepts.description: Apply preparation, detection, analysis, containment, eradication, recovery, and lessons learned activities.

concepts.name: Incident response training and testing
concepts.description: Use training, tabletop exercises, and simulations to prepare responders.

concepts.name: Root cause analysis and threat hunting
concepts.description: Find the underlying cause of incidents and proactively search for hidden adversary activity.

concepts.name: Digital forensics
concepts.description: Acquire, preserve, analyze, and report digital evidence using defensible procedures.

concepts.name: Legal hold and chain of custody
concepts.description: Preserve potentially relevant information and document evidence possession and handling.

concepts.name: Acquisition, preservation, reporting, and e-discovery
concepts.description: Collect and preserve information for investigations or legal discovery and report findings appropriately.

concepts.name: Investigation log sources
concepts.description: Use firewall, application, endpoint, operating-system security, IDS/IPS, and network logs to support investigations.

concepts.name: Investigation metadata
concepts.description: Use contextual metadata such as timestamps, addresses, identities, and file attributes to connect events.

concepts.name: Scans, automated reports, and dashboards
concepts.description: Use vulnerability scans, generated reports, and dashboards to summarize security posture and findings.

concepts.name: Packet captures
concepts.description: Inspect packet-level network traffic when flow summaries or logs are insufficient.
